name: str_copy_ret_end
purpose: strcpy variant: copies src (NUL included) to dst and returns a pointer to the NUL written in dst, so successive calls append. Used by the shop text expander to build 0xb7fa. Ghidra order is (src, dst).
notes: Also reachable through vectors 1778:02f6/057e/05f6/07b2 (belong to other overlays sharing the address).

name: print_shop_text
purpose: Expands a shop text (SHOPPE.DAT style) into the buffer at 0xb7fa and prints it with print_string. Bytes >= 0x80 index the compressed word table (pointer at 0x23ea + 2*byte, i.e. the .TLK word list) and are emitted with a leading space, plus a trailing space when a plain character follows. Macros: '#' shop name (ptr 0xaafc), '$' shopkeeper name (0xaafe), '&' item name (0xab00), '*' location name (0xac62), '%' price 0xb118 as signed decimal (itoa), '^' quantity 0xb11a, '@' morning/afternoon/evening by g_hour (<12, <18). Plain runs are copied by temporarily writing a NUL into the source at the macro position and restoring it; the final run is copied with its NUL.
notes: Local 6-byte itoa buffer; Rust uses an 8-byte scratch buffer.

name: print_shoppe_dat
purpose: Loads 0x5dc bytes of SHOPPE.DAT from file_offset into 0xb21e (g_ool_buffer) and prints the NUL-terminated text there through print_shop_text.

name: shadowlord_cheat_gold
purpose: Called after every purchase. When g_save_unk_3b2 (TOWN's g_shadowlord_present: index of the Shadowlord in town, -1 none) is 0 (Faulinei, Shadowlord of Falsehood) the shopkeeper cheats the party out of a further 1..64 gold (sub_i16_floor on g_gold).

0x5958.name: g_shadowlord_present
0x5958.meaning: index of the Shadowlord present in town, -1 none

notes: TALK's shadowlord_steals_item uses the same test.

name: print_greeting
purpose:
Prints a double quote and one of the four random greeting texts of the current shop type (SHOPPE.DAT offsets at 0x3b2a + type*8 + rand(0..3)*2), then a prompt separator: '

:' when the cursor column is >= 12, '
:' at column 0, else a single space.

0x3b2a.name: g_shop_greeting_offs
0x3b2a.meaning: SHOPPE.DAT offsets of greetings per shop type

name: print_farewell
purpose:
Farewell text: bought==0 prints '

"' and a random 'nothing bought' line (offsets 0x3b6a + type*8 + rand*2), bought==1 prints '

"' and a random 'thanks' line (0x3baa table); in both cases a newline when the cursor is not at column 0, then 'says $.
'. Other values (e.g. -1 after a sell session or a refusal) print nothing.

name: ask_yes_no
purpose: Reads command keys until 'Y' or 'N', echoes 'Yes'/'No' (0x786a/0x7866) and returns the key code (0x59/0x4e). Used by SHOPPES3 (inn) through vector 1778:07e2.

name: guild_buy_item
proto: int guild_buy_item(int member, int item, int result)
purpose: Guild purchase of item 0 keys (3 per purchase), 1 gems (4), 2 torches (5). Price = 0x3bea[slot*4+item] plus price*(100-3*intelligence)/100 (the common intelligence adjustment; the division is unsigned 32-bit so int>33 yields garbage - kept). Prints the item's pitch (SHOPPE.DAT offset 0x3c0a[item]) and 'Interested?'. 'N': 'What else, then?' and the result is returned unchanged. 'Y': with price <= gold the gold is deducted, shadowlord_cheat_gold, status window redrawn, goods added (cap 99), '"Sold!" says $. "What else, m'lady/m'lord?' (gender glyph at record+9 == 0xc is female) and 1 is returned; otherwise SHOPPE.DAT 0x21e6 ('Death comes always to those who cheat the Guild!' warns $.) and -1.

0x3bea.name: g_guild_prices
0x3bea.meaning: guild prices per town slot (keys, gems, torches, ?)

0x3c0a.name: g_guild_pitch_offs
0x3c0a.meaning: SHOPPE.DAT offsets of the item pitches

name: guild_menu
purpose: Guild menu loop: prints 'a.........Keys', 'b.........Gems', 'c......Torches', 'Thy concern?' and reads command keys. 'A'..'C' echo the lower-case letter and call guild_buy_item (result -1 ends the loop), 'D' prints SHOPPE.DAT 0x2215 ('That offer is for a limited time only'), space/Esc end the loop, anything else is ignored silently. After a valid key the menu is reprinted. Returns the last result (0 nothing, 1 bought, -1 could not pay).

name: guild_shop
purpose: Guild (shop type 5) entry from TALK: print_greeting, then 'Y' prints 'Yes "We sell:' and runs guild_menu; space or 'N' prints 'No'. Ends with print_farewell(result).

name: reagent_buy_item
proto: int reagent_buy_item(int member, int choice, int result)
purpose: Reagent purchase: locates the choice-th (0-based) reagent this shop stocks (price byte 0x3a32[slot*8+i] != 0); none -> returns -2. Already 99 of it -> 'Thou canst not carry any more!' and a key wait (result unchanged). Otherwise price = that byte with the intelligence adjustment (high word 0), quantity 0xb11a = 0x3a5a[slot*8+i], prints the reagent name (0x97b7 + 0x3c10[i], expanded) and ' Is this thy need?' (plus '\n:' when the column > 12). 'N' -> 'What else?'; 'Y' -> if affordable pays (cheat, status), adds the quantity to g_reagents[i] (cap 99), '"I thank thee!" says $.' 'Anything else?' and returns 1, else prints the text at 0xb6e2 (offset 0x4c4 of the loaded reagent block: 'Thou profaneth my shoppe with thine empty purse! OUT!') and returns -1.

0x3a32.name: g_reagent_prices
0x3a32.meaning: reagent price per shop slot (0 = not stocked)

0x3c10.name: g_reagent_name_offs
0x3c10.meaning: offsets of the long reagent names relative to 0x97b7

name: reagent_menu
purpose: Loads the reagent-shop text block (SHOPPE.DAT 0x1a67, 0x5dc bytes) into 0xb21e and loops: lists stocked reagents as 'A...Name' (names 0x3c20[i]) and 'Thy interest?'; 'A'..'E' call reagent_buy_item (-1 ends with result -1, -2 = no such entry is ignored, otherwise the list is reprinted), Enter/space/Esc end the menu. Returns the last result.

name: reagent_shop
purpose: Reagent seller (shop type 4) entry from TALK: greeting; 'Y' prints 'Yes "Fine! We sell:' and runs reagent_menu, space/'N' prints 'No'; print_farewell(result).

name: horse_shop
purpose: Stables (shop type 2). Counts to the first free g_monster_table slot and scans the four neighbours of the party (dx 0x3c38 / dy 0x3c40: N, S, E, W) for a cell with no object whose map tile is 'D' (0x44), 'E' (0x45) or 5. No free slot (32) or no cell -> 'The stables are closed.' Otherwise price = 0x3c30[slot] with the intelligence adjustment, greeting; space/'N' -> 'No'; 'Y' -> pitch (SHOPPE.DAT 0x1643) and 'Deal?': 'N' -> 'No'; 'Y' -> 'Yes!' then 'Thou couldst not afford to feed it!' (result -1) or payment (cheat) and a horse object is written to the slot: tile/frame 0x10, x/y of the cell, z = g_party_z, value1/2/3 = 0; refresh_map_view and draw_status_window (result 1). print_farewell(result).

name: arms_buy_item
proto: int arms_buy_item(int member, int item, int result)
purpose: Arms purchase of inventory item id `item`: price = 0x3a82[item] (i16 base prices for ids 0..0x2f) with the intelligence adjustment; prints the item pitch from SHOPPE.DAT (offset 0x3c48[item]), a random 'Wouldst thou buy one?' phrase (0x3ca6) and the closing quote. 'N' -> 'No'. 'Y' -> 'Yes': 99 held -> 'Thou canst not carry any more!' says $. + key wait; gold < price -> random insult (0x3cae) 'yells $.' and result -1; else pay (shadowlord cheat, status window), arrows 0x1b / quarrels 0x1d set to 99, other items +1 (cap 99), 'Sold!' and result 1. Unless -1, prints 'Anything else,' + 'then?' (result 0) / 'milady?' (gender 0xc) / 'sir?'. Returns result.

0x3a82.name: g_arms_prices
0x3a82.meaning: base buy price per arms item id (0 = cannot be traded)

name: arms_buy_menu
purpose: Arms 'Buy' menu loop: lists the shop's stock (item ids at 0x3ae2[slot*8+n], 0xff-terminated, max 8) as 'a...Name' (long name 0x17f6 when < 13 chars else short name 0x1962), one per line, a blank line, a random 'What may I show thee?' (0x3cb6) and the quote. A letter within the stock echoes lower-case and calls arms_buy_item (-1 ends the loop); Esc/space end it; other keys ignored; after a valid key the list is reprinted. Returns the last result.

0x3ae2.name: g_arms_stock
0x3ae2.meaning: item ids stocked per arms shop slot, 0xff terminated

name: has_sellable_arms
purpose: Returns 1 when any of g_inventory[0..0x2f] (helms, shields, armour, weapons, rings, amulets) is non-zero, else 0.

name: draw_sell_list
purpose: Redraws the 4-row sell list in text window 1. If the cursor item is no longer owned the cursor is repaired: when cursor == top it moves to the previous owned item (or the first owned item when none) and top follows; otherwise to the next owned item, or at the end to the last owned item while top moves back one entry when possible (ZSTATS prev_owned/next_owned with member 0xff over g_inventory, n = 0x30). Rows 1..4 from (1,1) print the owned items from top with ZSTATS print_item_line(marker '-', short names 0x1962), the cursor line wrapped in 0xfd highlight codes, until row 5 or the list ends; remaining rows are blanked with 13 spaces (0x7c50). More-indicator at (6,6): 0x18 (more above), 0x19 (more below), 0x12 (both) between bar caps, or draw_status_separator when neither. Returns the window row of the cursor line (uninitialised in the original when no row matched). Reselects window 2.
notes: Rust takes &mut i16 for both locals instead of DGROUP pointers. Calls ZSTATS via vectors 1778:0806/0812/081e.

name: arms_sell_item
purpose: Sells one unit of item id `item`. Arrows (0x1b)/quarrels (0x1d): 'We don't deal in used ammunition!' growls $. and returns 1 (ends the session). Otherwise '\n\n"'; base price 0x3a82[item] == 0 -> 'That, I cannot buy from thee.' says $.; else offer 0xb118 = (intelligence * price (16-bit) * 3) / 100 + 1 (unsigned 32-bit divide), item name for '&' = 0x3cce[item] (sell names, e.g. 'Cloth suit') or the long name 0x17f6[item], a random offer phrase from the loaded sell text block (0x3cbe[rand 0..7] are SHOPPE.DAT offsets; minus 0x59a2 maps them into the 0xb21e buffer loaded from offset 0xbc0) and 'Deal?'. 'N' -> 'No'; 'Y' -> 'Yes "Done!" says $.', gold += offer (cap 9999), count -= 1 (floor 0). print_gold_line. Returns 0.

0x3cce.name: g_arms_sell_name_ptrs
0x3cce.meaning: alternative item names for selling (0 = use long name)

0x3cbe.name: g_arms_sell_offer_offs
0x3cbe.meaning: SHOPPE.DAT offsets of the offer phrases (block 0xbc0)

name: arms_sell_browser
purpose: Arms 'Sell' browser (takes the member; the stub lacked it - RET 2). No sellable arms -> print_nothing_to_sell. Otherwise a random 'What dost thou wish to sell?' (0x3d2e), the 'Arms' status title, a 4-row frame in window 1 (define_text_window 6/0x26/1/0x18 then 9/0x27/1/0x18; glyphs 0x10-0x17), cursor = top = first owned item, draw_sell_list, sell-offer text block loaded (SHOPPE.DAT 0xbc0). Key loop (Ghidra fragments b34c/b3b4/b41a/b436/b47a/b4c6/b4ce/b4f6): 1/3 up one, 2/4 down one, PgUp 0xd5 up four, PgDn 0xd6 down four, Home 0xd3 first item, End 0xd4 last item with top up to three back, Enter/space arms_sell_item on the cursor item then (while arms remain and not refused) redraw + random 'What else can ye offer me?' (0x3d3e), else the session ends; Esc ends. Moving down past row 4 scrolls top forward; moving up while on top scrolls top back. Ends with finish_sell_browser(refused).
notes: Up-move with cursor != top assigns prev_owned's result even when -1 (original quirk kept).

name: fn_1000_b34c_fragment
purpose: Fragment of arms_sell_browser: keys 1/3/PgUp move the cursor up (step 4 for 0xd5), scrolling top when the cursor sits on it; then redraw.

name: fn_1000_b41a_fragment
purpose: Fragment of arms_sell_browser: Home sets cursor = top = first owned item and redraws.

name: fn_1000_b436_fragment
purpose: Fragment of arms_sell_browser: End sets cursor = last owned item and top up to three owned entries before it, then redraws.

name: fn_1000_b47a_fragment
purpose: Fragment of arms_sell_browser: Enter/space sell the cursor item (arms_sell_item); if not refused and arms remain the list is redrawn and a random 'What else can ye offer me?' printed, else the done flag is set.

name: fn_1000_b4c6_fragment
purpose: Fragment of arms_sell_browser: Esc sets the done flag. Catalog name COMBAT_b4c6 / vector 1778:0602 refer to COMBAT's code at the same address.

name: fn_1000_b4ce_fragment
purpose: Fragment of arms_sell_browser: dispatch of keys > 0xd (Esc, space, Home, End, PgUp, PgDn; others ignored).

name: finish_sell_browser
proto: void finish_sell_browser(int refused)  /* tail of b1f4 using its local */
purpose:
Tail of arms_sell_browser: draw_status_window, draw_status_top_bar; unless the session ended with the ammunition refusal (local -0x10 != 0) prints '

"' + random farewell (0x3d36) + '"
' and, while arms remain, 'says $.
'. Falls into the b1f4 epilogue (RET 2).

name: print_nothing_to_sell
purpose: Tail of arms_sell_browser when has_sellable_arms is 0: print_shop_text 0x7f20 'Thou hast nothing to sell!" growls $.' then the epilogue.

name: arms_shop
purpose: Arms seller (shop type 0) entry from TALK: '"Good @, and welcome to #!"', a key wait, '$ says, "' + one of two greetings (0x3d46) + '" '. Then 'B' -> 'Buy', random 'Very good!' (0x3d4a) and 'We have:' (0x3d52), arms_buy_menu; 'S' -> 'Sell', arms_sell_browser(member), result -1 (no farewell text); space -> 'No'. print_farewell(result).

name: select_patient
purpose: Healer patient choice: a single-member party returns 0 silently; otherwise '"Who needs my aid?"' and select_party_member_no_zero (-1 cancelled -> 'No one'). Returns the member index.

name: healing_light_effect
purpose: Visual/sound effect of a healing: XOR-fills the 8x8 cell at (0xb7,0xb7) in g_ui_color0 with two sweep noises (5000..0x57e4 up, 27500.. down, phase step 0x100e), the same cell in g_ui_color1 with sweeps (1..40000 / 40000.., phase 0x11b2), then a final XOR fill with sweeps (step 2, 1..18000 / 36000.., phase 0x8fc).
notes: Ghidra rendered the numeric constants as string-symbol offsets (s_STARTSC_16+10 = 0x1388 etc.).

name: ask_healer_payment
purpose: Prints 'for % gold. Wilt thou pay?' (price 0xb118) and reads Y/N (echoed). Returns true when the service is refused: 'N', or 'Y' without enough gold unless price <= 100 and g_location == 7 (Skara Brae healer treats the poor for free); the refusal prints SHOPPE.DAT 0x23ab 'I am truly sorry, but I cannot accept charity cases.' says $. When affordable the gold is deducted and shadowlord_cheat_gold applied.
notes: Returns false (service performed, nothing paid) for the charity case.

name: healer_shop
purpose: Healer (shop type 6) entry from TALK. Takes the member argument (RET 2) but never reads it (the stub and TALK's caller lacked it; fixed). print_greeting, then Y/N: 'N' leaves; 'Y' prints 'We have powers to Cure, Heal, or Resurrect.' says $. 'What is the nature of thy need?' and reads C/H/R (Enter/space -> 'Nothing' and the loop ends). Cure: patient via select_patient; status must be 'P' else 'Thou hast no need of this art!' says $. (0x3d5a); in location 5 (Minoc) 'Receive now the Light!' free, else 'I can cure thy poisoned body ' + ask_healer_payment(0x3d8e[slot]); then healing_light_effect and status 'G'. Heal: refused when 'D' or HP == max HP; free in Minoc, else 'I can heal thee ' + 0x3d86[slot]; light and HP = max HP. Resurrect: status must be 'D'; 'I can raise this unfortunate person from the dead ' + 0x3d96[slot] (u16); on payment light, CAST2 in_mani_corp_resurrect(0xff, member), HP = max HP, draw_status_window. After each service the status window is redrawn and 'Is there any other way in which I may aid thee?' asked. print_farewell(1).
